summary: Build practical employment law skills for contracts, investigations, discipline, and compliance. Explore the five-day HR training course.
lede: Employment law training helps HR professionals assess workplace decisions and document fair, defensible processes. It is designed for HR business partners, employee relations managers and compliance specialists who need to translate applicable requirements into consistent procedures. Practice includes reviewing contract terms, planning investigations, and recording disciplinary or termination decisions, with attention to workplace rights, employee data and risk controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with employees, managers, contracts, workplace cases, or HR governance and need a structured approach to employment law decisions across varied legal environments.
modules: Employment Law Foundations and ILO Standards
Employee Data and Digital HR Compliance
Employment Law Governance and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in HR, people operations, employee relations, recruitment, HR compliance, or line management. Familiarity with your organization’s employment policies and access to representative, anonymized HR documents will help you apply the exercises. No programming is required. Advanced digital topics receive operational application treatment, not technical implementation.
